world.title: Iran targets US base in first attack since Trump halted strikes
world.summary: Iran launched multiple ballistic missiles at a US military base in Jordan on Tuesday, marking the first such attack since President Trump paused strikes on Iran. The US Central Command (CENTCOM) reported that all missiles were intercepted. This incident raises concerns about potential regional escalation, despite ongoing diplomatic efforts to ease tensions between the two nations.

world.title: How Reza Pahlavi's decades-long wait for power slipped away
world.summary: Reza Pahlavi, the exiled son of Iran's last shah, saw a potential opportunity for power following US-Israeli strikes on Iran, which plunged the country into crisis. However, the Islamic Republic endured, and the US maintained a distance. Doubts regarding Pahlavi's funding and political support have raised uncertainties about his ambitions for leadership in Iran.

world.title: Trump will give lifeguard Ryder Williams High Civilian Honor at White House after rescuing a 10-year-old boy
world.summary: President Donald Trump will honor 16-year-old lifeguard Ryder Williams with a “High Civilian Honor” at the White House. This recognition follows Williams' courageous act of rescuing a 10-year-old boy from perilous surf conditions at a California beach in Santa Cruz. The event will include Williams and his family, celebrating the teenager's bravery and quick response in a dangerous situation.

business.title: ET Exclusive: Adani eyes controlling stake in UK's Associated British Ports
business.summary: Adani Ports is considering a bid for a controlling stake in Associated British Ports in the UK, which would significantly expand Gautam Adani's port operations. The stake is currently held by two Canadian pension funds. Associated British Ports operates twenty-one key ports across the UK and is also involved in the offshore wind industry.

business.title: Here's what is contributing to it and what lies ahead
business.summary: All Nifty IT constituents have posted positive returns this month, led by Persistent Systems, HCLTech, and LTM, which gained 20% to 25%. TCS, Tech Mahindra, Coforge, Mphasis, and Infosys saw increases of 10% to 20%. Wipro and Oracle Financial underperformed with 6% gains. Nifty IT is on track for its best month in six years.

business.title: Quantum Cryptography That Humans Spent Years Failing to Break
business.summary: Anthropic announced that an unreleased version of its AI model identified two new attacks on cryptographic algorithms, including one targeting the HAWK signature scheme, which is in contention for U.S. federal standardization. This discovery highlights vulnerabilities in post-quantum cryptography that researchers had previously struggled to uncover, raising concerns about the security of emerging cryptographic methods.

technology.title: Windows 11 KB5101684 out with a speed boost, direct download links for offline installer (.msu)
technology.summary: Windows 11 KB5101684 has been released, featuring various quality improvements, especially in performance. Users can access this update through Windows Update, requiring them to click the ‘Download & Install’ button. Additionally, Microsoft has provided direct download links for offline installers in the .msu format. This update is optional and is known internally by a specific code.

technology.title: Xiaomi Redmi Note 17 to launch in India next month
technology.summary: Xiaomi is set to launch the Redmi Note 17 in India on August 6. The device features an 8,000mAh battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 processor, AMOLED display, and a 50MP camera. The launch will coincide with the introduction of the Vivo S2. Additional details about the device's specifications and features are expected to be revealed at the event.

technology.title: Samsung Smart Glasses Update: The Design-First Bet and Its Tradeoffs
technology.summary: Samsung introduced its AI-powered smart glasses at the Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22. These display-free frames operate on Android XR and feature Google Gemini technology. The design collaboration involved Gentle Monster and Warby Parker. The smart glasses are set to launch in the fall, emphasizing a design-first approach while balancing functionality and aesthetic considerations.

sports.title: Babar reveals extent of Masood injury after West Indies loss
sports.summary: Pakistan captain Babar Azam announced that Shan Masood fractured his finger during the first Test against the West Indies. The injury occurred while Masood was batting in the first innings. His availability for the remainder of the series will be assessed as the team continues to monitor his condition following the injury sustained in Trinidad.

sports.title: Klopp appointment sparks Antonio Rüdiger U-turn on Germany future
sports.summary: Antonio Rüdiger was reportedly considering retirement from international football following Germany's World Cup defeat to Paraguay. However, the recent appointment of Jürgen Klopp as the national team's coach has prompted the experienced defender to reassess his decision. Rüdiger now sees potential for a renewed commitment to the national team under Klopp's leadership, reigniting his international career aspirations.

sports.title: YOR vs WOR Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: Yorkshire (YOR) will compete against Worcestershire (WOR) in the England Domestic One-Day Cup on July 29, 2026, at Clifton Park Ground, York, starting at 3:30 PM IST. This match marks the return of English cricket to the One-Day Cup following the Vitality Blast and The 100. Worcestershire enters as the defending champions. Betting tips and odds are available.

health.title: Fatty liver, not hepatitis, is now India’s fastest-growing liver threat, warn AIIMS doctors
health.summary: Doctors at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in New Delhi report that fatty liver disease, also known as Metabolic dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD), is now India's fastest-growing liver threat, surpassing hepatitis. This increase is attributed to rising obesity, diabetes, and sedentary lifestyles, despite advancements in hepatitis B and C vaccinations and treatments.

health.title: Healthy life expectancy is falling behind as people live longer
health.summary: A global study reveals that people now spend an average of 10.7 years in poor health, an increase from 8.8 years in 1990. The gap between overall life expectancy and healthy life expectancy is widening, with 203 out of 204 countries experiencing faster growth in lifespan compared to healthy years. This trend raises concerns about health quality in aging populations.

health.title: Kidney transplant: A second chance at life How ABO-incompatible transplant works
health.summary: ABO-incompatible kidney transplants are addressing donor shortages and enhancing survival rates for patients with kidney failure. These transplants allow individuals with different blood types to receive kidneys from incompatible donors. This medical advancement helps maintain essential bodily functions by filtering waste and toxins, offering patients a second chance at life when traditional treatment options are insufficient.

science.title: NASA Astronaut Chris Williams Returns After 241 Days on ISS
science.summary: NASA astronaut Chris Williams and Roscosmos cosmonauts Sergey Kud-Sverchkov and Sergei Mikaev safely landed in Kazakhstan on July 26, 2026, after spending 241 days aboard the International Space Station. Their Soyuz MS-28 spacecraft undocked from the ISS, concluding a mission that confirmed various scientific objectives. The astronauts are now back on Earth following their extended stay in space.

science.title: Private mission to rescue NASA's aging telescope runs into its own trouble
science.summary: Katalyst Space Technologies announced that its Link satellite, part of a private mission to rescue NASA's aging telescope, is facing thruster issues. The satellite has entered an uncontrollable spin, disrupting communication. This setback occurred three weeks after the deployment of a three-armed robot designed for the mission. The situation complicates efforts to assist the aging telescope.

science.title: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket stage will hit the Moon in the coming days
science.summary: The upper stage of a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket is set to collide with the Moon in the coming days. Scientists plan to observe and study the event, which may also be visible from Earth under favorable conditions. SpaceX regularly conducts launches for various missions, and this impact will provide a unique opportunity for lunar observation.

entertainment.title: Raja Chaudhary on daughter Palak Tiwari's dating rumours with Ibrahim Ali Khan: ‘Just a biological father, don't care’
entertainment.summary: Raja Chaudhary commented on his daughter Palak Tiwari's dating rumors with Ibrahim Ali Khan, stating he feels indifferent about her career and personal life due to their lack of a relationship. He emphasized that he is merely a biological father and does not engage in her affairs. Chaudhary's remarks highlight the distance between them.

entertainment.title: Scorpio Horoscope Today: July 29, 2026
entertainment.summary: Scorpio horoscope for July 29, 2026, emphasizes the importance of choice. Scorpios are encouraged to decide whether to wait or walk away, stand firm or yield, and trust their intuition or hesitate before acting. The horoscope highlights that their strength is rooted in endurance, suggesting that careful consideration of their options will lead to better outcomes.
